## [1.15.0](https://github.com/jordanwoodson/lurk-morphe-patches/compare/v1.14.4...v1.15.0) (2026-10-27)

### Kick

#### ✨ New Features

* add Lurk to Kick's account menu

### Twitch

#### ✨ New Features

* add a Lurk row to Twitch's Settings screen
* add **Emote and badge info**
* add **Fill screen**
* **Chat appearance:** emote, badge and text sizes, message spacing

### Shared

#### ✨ New Features

* **settings:** open Lurk settings from App info and keep the shortcut on top
